# RAG retrieval evaluation corpus (TASK_VL_RETRIEVAL_HARDENING_AND_CLOSEOUT_V2 P4)

The standing regression set for multimodal-retrieval changes. `queries.yaml` is
the labelled query set; the PDFs are **not committed** — synthetic ones are
regenerated by the builder below, real ones are fetched or operator-provided per
`manifest.yaml`.

Run it (VL server on `:8942` must be `ready`, RAG MCP on `:8921` up):

```
python scripts/rag_retrieval_eval.py <corpus_dir> tests/fixtures/rag_eval_corpus/queries.yaml \
    --fusion rrf --out reports/runtime/eval_rrf.json
```

`--fusion` ∈ `rrf` (current) · `rerank_tiebreak` · `score_aware` (P5). Reports
recall@1, recall@5, MRR per category (`diagram_only` / `prose_only` / `mixed`).
For `diagram_only` a text hit on the right file does **not** count — the figure
page must come back.

## Corpus composition (36 docs)

| set | n | source |
|---|---|---|
| synthetic figure docs | 9 | `build_synthetic.py` below — page-1 generic prose, page-2 figure; the discriminating content is **only** on the image (provable prose-absence — the controls) |
| public NERC CIP standards | 17 | `manifest.yaml` fetch URLs (CIP-002 … CIP-015) |
| NIST SP 800-82r3 architecture slice | 1 | `manifest.yaml` — 92-page slice (SCADA/DCS/PLC + defense-in-depth figures) |
| internal OT/CIP procedures | 9 | operator-provided, not fetchable — distractor pressure |

## Synthetic builder

```python
"""Build the synthetic control set. Two-page PDFs: page 1 generic governance
prose, page 2 a single rendered figure whose discriminating content (a valve
tag, an IP, a setpoint, a legend entry) is ONLY on the image. Several figures
carry deliberately small text (P&ID bubbles, HMI rows) — the case max_pixels /
render-DPI governs (E2).  Usage: python build_synthetic.py OUT_DIR
"""
import io, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else Path(__file__).parent / "synthetic"

def _font(size, bold=False):
    name = "Arial Bold.ttf" if bold else "Arial.ttf"
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(f"/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/{name}", size)
    except OSError:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

H1, BODY, SMALL, TINY = _font(24, True), _font(17), _font(15), _font(12)

def pid_reactor():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 1050), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 3-1  Reactor Feed Loop  (P&ID sheet 3 of 7)", font=H1, fill="black")
    d.rectangle([120, 210, 320, 530], outline="black", width=3); d.text((140, 350), "V-204\nSurge Drum", font=SMALL, fill="black")
    d.line([320, 370, 700, 370], fill="black", width=3); d.ellipse([690, 340, 750, 400], outline="black", width=3)
    d.text((640, 410), "FV-101", font=TINY, fill="black"); d.text((560, 440), "air-to-open / fail-closed", font=TINY, fill="red")
    d.rectangle([1100, 310, 1320, 470], outline="black", width=3); d.text((1130, 370), "P-201\nFeed Pump", font=SMALL, fill="black")
    d.ellipse([480, 130, 560, 210], outline="black", width=2); d.text((498, 155), "FIC\n101", font=TINY, fill="black")
    d.ellipse([300, 570, 380, 650], outline="black", width=2); d.text((318, 595), "LT\n204", font=TINY, fill="black")
    d.text((40, 740), "Interlock I-3:  LT-204 HH -> close XV-205, trip P-201 (manual reset)", font=SMALL, fill="black")
    d.text((40, 780), "Setpoint: FIC-101 = 47.5 gpm     Trip: LT-204 = 92%", font=SMALL, fill="black")
    return im, ["FV-101", "47.5 gpm", "XV-205", "LT-204", "I-3"]

def pid_compressor():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 1000), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 4-2  K-501 Recycle Compressor - Anti-Surge", font=H1, fill="black")
    d.ellipse([200, 300, 460, 560], outline="black", width=3); d.text((250, 410), "K-501", font=BODY, fill="black")
    d.line([460, 430, 900, 430], fill="black", width=3); d.rectangle([900, 360, 1080, 500], outline="black", width=3)
    d.text((915, 415), "E-506\ncooler", font=TINY, fill="black")
    d.ellipse([640, 150, 720, 230], outline="blue", width=3); d.text((652, 175), "UV\n551", font=TINY, fill="blue")
    d.text((40, 700), "Anti-surge valve UV-551 opens on: (Pd/Ps) > 2.35  OR  flow < 8,200 kg/h", font=SMALL, fill="red")
    d.text((40, 740), "Recycle line 8 in Sch 40; check valve CV-509 downstream of E-506", font=SMALL, fill="black")
    return im, ["UV-551", "2.35", "8,200 kg/h", "CV-509", "E-506"]

def esp_plant_b():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 950), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 5-2  Electronic Security Perimeter - Plant B", font=H1, fill="black")
    d.rectangle([60, 110, 700, 860], outline="blue", width=3); d.text((80, 120), "ESP-B  (10.20.0.0/16)", font=SMALL, fill="blue")
    d.rectangle([110, 200, 430, 380], outline="black", width=2); d.text((130, 270), "HMI-B1  10.20.4.11", font=TINY, fill="black")
    d.rectangle([110, 460, 430, 640], outline="black", width=2); d.text((130, 520), "PLC-B7  10.20.8.30  rack 0 / slot 2", font=TINY, fill="black")
    d.rectangle([820, 320, 1400, 660], outline="green", width=3); d.text((840, 330), "Corporate  (10.99.0.0/16)", font=SMALL, fill="green")
    d.line([700, 430, 820, 430], fill="red", width=4)
    d.text((640, 690), "FW-B allows: TCP 502 inbound from 10.99.7.5 only; all else deny", font=TINY, fill="red")
    return im, ["10.20.8.30", "PLC-B7", "TCP 502", "10.99.7.5", "10.20.4.11"]

def network_arch():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 1000), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 2-4  Control Center Reference Architecture (Purdue)", font=H1, fill="black")
    levels = [("Level 3.5  DMZ", "hist-replica 172.19.5.20 : patch-relay 172.19.5.30"),
              ("Level 3  Site Ops", "AD-OT 172.20.1.10 : WSUS-OT 172.20.1.14"),
              ("Level 2  Supervisory", "HMI-01..04 172.21.4.0/24 : eng-ws 172.21.4.51"),
              ("Level 1  Control", "PLC bus 172.22.8.0/24 : safety PLC 172.22.9.5")]
    y = 130
    for name, detail in levels:
        d.rectangle([80, y, 1420, y + 150], outline="black", width=2)
        d.text((100, y + 15), name, font=BODY, fill="black"); d.text((100, y + 70), detail, font=TINY, fill="black")
        y += 190
    d.text((40, 900), "One-way diode from Level 3 hist to 3.5 replica only; no return path", font=SMALL, fill="red")
    return im, ["172.22.9.5", "172.21.4.51", "WSUS-OT", "172.19.5.30", "one-way diode"]

def hmi_alarm():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 950), (12, 24, 40)); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 7-4  Alarm Summary Page - Unit 2", font=H1, fill="white")
    rows = [("07:14:22", "PAH-2201  Discharge pressure HIGH", "UNACK", "red"),
            ("07:15:03", "TAH-2240  Bearing temp HIGH-HIGH", "ACK", "yellow"),
            ("07:16:41", "LAL-2118  Seal pot level LOW", "RTN", "white"),
            ("07:19:55", "FAL-2077  Lube oil flow LOW", "UNACK", "red")]
    y = 130
    for ts, txt, st, col in rows:
        d.text((60, y), f"{ts}  {txt}", font=SMALL, fill=col); d.text((1240, y), st, font=SMALL, fill=col); y += 55
    d.text((60, 400), "Shelved: MAL-2302 (shelved 06:02, expires 14:02)", font=TINY, fill="white")
    return im, ["PAH-2201", "TAH-2240", "FAL-2077", "MAL-2302", "seal pot level LOW"]

def hmi_trend():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 900), (18, 18, 18)); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 6-1  Trend Group TG-14  (Deaerator)", font=H1, fill="white")
    d.rectangle([120, 120, 1400, 700], outline="gray", width=2)
    for i, (lbl, col, val) in enumerate([("PT-1401 pressure", "cyan", "4.2 barg"), ("LT-1402 level", "lime", "58 %"), ("TT-1403 temp", "orange", "142 C")]):
        d.text((140, 720 + i * 30), f"{lbl}   last = {val}", font=TINY, fill=col)
    d.text((140, 820), "Group scan 2 s; PT-1401 span 0-10 barg; deviation alarm at +/- 0.6 barg", font=TINY, fill="white")
    return im, ["PT-1401", "4.2 barg", "TT-1403", "142 C", "TG-14"]

def relay_setting():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 1000), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 8-3  Feeder 12L4 Protection Settings (SEL-751)", font=H1, fill="black")
    for j, (a, b, c) in enumerate([("50P1  inst. phase OC", "pickup 2400 A", "delay 0.00 s"),
                                   ("51P  time phase OC", "pickup 480 A", "U3 curve, TD 3.5"),
                                   ("50G1  inst. ground OC", "pickup 320 A", "delay 0.05 s"),
                                   ("27  undervoltage", "pickup 0.85 pu", "delay 2.0 s")]):
        y = 140 + j * 70
        d.text((80, y), a, font=SMALL, fill="black"); d.text((620, y), b, font=SMALL, fill="black"); d.text((1050, y), c, font=SMALL, fill="black")
    d.text((80, 500), "CT ratio 600:5   PT ratio 14400:120   Breaker 12L4-52 close 5 cyc", font=TINY, fill="black")
    return im, ["50P1", "2400 A", "51P", "0.85 pu", "SEL-751"]

def legend_map():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1400, 1000), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 1-2  Site Plot Plan - Legend", font=H1, fill="black")
    for j, (code, meaning) in enumerate([("HH", "fire monitor / hydrant"), ("GD", "gas detector (IR point)"),
                                         ("MAC", "manual call point"), ("ESD-2", "unit emergency shutdown pushbutton"),
                                         ("AG", "assembly / muster area")]):
        y = 140 + j * 70
        d.rectangle([80, y, 150, y + 40], outline="black", width=2); d.text((95, y + 8), code, font=SMALL, fill="black")
        d.text((180, y + 8), meaning, font=SMALL, fill="black")
    d.text((80, 540), "Prevailing wind WSW; primary muster AG-1 north gate, alternate AG-3 river dock", font=TINY, fill="black")
    return im, ["ESD-2", "manual call point", "GD", "AG-3", "assembly / muster area"]

def valve_schedule():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 1050), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.text((40, 20), "FIGURE 9-1  Car-Seal / Locked-Valve Schedule (extract)", font=H1, fill="black")
    for j, (tag, svc, state, why) in enumerate([("CSO-118", "PSV-410 A inlet", "car-seal OPEN", "relief path"),
                                                ("CSC-119", "PSV-410 A bypass", "car-seal CLOSED", "relief path"),
                                                ("LC-241", "N2 to reactor jacket", "locked CLOSED", "contamination"),
                                                ("LO-255", "cooling water to E-506", "locked OPEN", "loss of cooling")]):
        y = 150 + j * 80
        d.text((80, y), tag, font=SMALL, fill="black"); d.text((320, y), svc, font=TINY, fill="black")
        d.text((820, y), state, font=SMALL, fill="red"); d.text((1150, y), why, font=TINY, fill="black")
    d.text((80, 560), "Position verified each turnaround; deviations logged to MOC-VLV register", font=TINY, fill="black")
    return im, ["CSO-118", "LC-241", "LO-255", "PSV-410 A", "MOC-VLV"]

PROSE = ("This document is part of the site management system and is maintained under the document "
         "control procedure. It is reviewed on the standard cycle and after any change that affects "
         "its content. The authoritative technical detail - equipment tags, addresses, setpoints, and "
         "protective settings - is held in the referenced drawings, the asset register, and the "
         "configuration management system, not reproduced in this narrative. Personnel performing work "
         "governed by this document must be trained and authorized. Deviations require management-of-"
         "change approval before implementation.")

SPECS = [("pid_reactor_feed.pdf", "pid", pid_reactor), ("pid_recycle_compressor.pdf", "pid", pid_compressor),
         ("esp_plant_b.pdf", "network", esp_plant_b), ("control_center_arch.pdf", "network", network_arch),
         ("hmi_alarm_summary.pdf", "hmi", hmi_alarm), ("hmi_trend_group.pdf", "hmi", hmi_trend),
         ("relay_settings_12l4.pdf", "electrical", relay_setting), ("plot_plan_legend.pdf", "legend", legend_map),
         ("locked_valve_schedule.pdf", "table", valve_schedule)]

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    index = []
    for fname, category, builder in SPECS:
        img, answers = builder()
        doc = pymupdf.open()
        p1 = doc.new_page(width=612, height=792)
        p1.insert_textbox(pymupdf.Rect(54, 72, 558, 720), PROSE, fontsize=11, fontname="helv")
        p2 = doc.new_page(width=612, height=792)
        buf = io.BytesIO(); img.save(buf, format="PNG")
        p2.insert_image(pymupdf.Rect(24, 48, 588, 48 + 540 * img.height / img.width), stream=buf.getvalue())
        p2.insert_textbox(pymupdf.Rect(54, 640, 558, 740), f"See the {fname[:-4]} drawing.", fontsize=10, fontname="helv")
        doc.save(str(OUT / fname)); doc.close()
        index.append({"file": fname, "category": category, "figure_answers": answers})
        print("wrote", OUT / fname)
    (OUT / "_index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2))
    print(f"{len(index)} synthetic docs at {OUT}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
